description: A feature complete direnv alternative for PowerShell Core, sourcing .env files as you change directory
notes: Requires PowerShell 7 or newer; the module does not work in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
Add 'Import-Module Dotenv' and 'Enable-Dotenv' to your PowerShell profile, then call 'Dotenv\Update-Dotenv' from your prompt function.
